privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires two specific Event Rules in Nx Witness. Rule 1: Event 'Storage Failure' (Any Server) -> Action 'HTTP Request' (POST) to https://ops-api.internal/webhooks/health. Rule 2: Event 'Soft Trigger' (Name: 'Panic Alert', Icon: Bell, Users: All, Cameras: Any) -> Action 'HTTP Request' (POST) to https://ops-api.internal/webhooks/panic. Note: For the Storage Health macro, official documentation uses {event.source}, but the task description specifies {event.sourceName}; both are acceptable. The JSON bodies must match the task description exactly, including the specific macros {event.time}, {user.name}, and {event.cameraId}.
